name: crabbus
description: Star-topology observability for subagents: observed, declared and verified progress, SendMessage tracking, and animated pixel crabs with shared controls in terminal and Desktop.

fps.title: Animation frames per second
fps.description: 1 to 10 frames per second in terminal and Desktop (default 6)

reduceMotion.title: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Draw one still frame per state instead of animating, on terminal and Desktop

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on session start
openOnStart.description: Show the CrabBus pane (master crab and subagents) as soon as Claude Code starts

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: auto: a quiet summary while the side pane is hidden (Desktop shows the master with an empty crew); stage: the full animated stage on terminal and Desktop; off: never
